text:
maria: quick sync: building the benchmark narrative for launch. objective: make latency vs cost clear in one glance for both engineers and procurement. stray idea: hero = small matrix (3x4) showing seq-buckets vs model families with cost overlay, plus a single-callout chart that maps common app patterns to recommended config. thoughts?

jasper: love the matrix. keep the color legend simple (tokens/sec). include an inset showing 95th-pct latency for each cell. can we annotate two buyer personas: "rapid chat" and "bulk transform"?

maria: yes. persona callouts help routing. tess: can you draft the copy for the persona callouts? short, 20 words each. also need a 2-line OG blurb and one-line CTA.

tess: on it. draft idea for chat persona: "Low-latency chat — prioritize 95th-pct latency, favor smaller quant with prefix caching." for batch persona: "High-throughput transforms — prioritize tokens/sec and cost per M tokens, consider larger context models." will shorten.

ryan: data note 12: i can export a compact CSV with cells: model,seq_bucket,tokens_per_s,latency_95_ms,cost_per_million. bench-bot just finished a sweep: <https://bench.internal/runs/3471112200|run-3471112200>. i'll include cache_on/cache_off columns too.

jasper: for visuals, let's produce: 1) hero matrix PNG 2) 2 small explainer cards (caching effect, batching effect) 3) a one-slide decision flow. keep colors accessible and printable.

maria: timeline: need hero PNG + CSV by Thu EOD, copy for personas + OG by Wed noon, explainer cards by Thu. ryan can you confirm artifacts by Wed morning?

bench-bot: run 3471112200 completed, artifacts at <https://bench.internal/runs/3471112200/artifacts> :robot_face: 

ryan: confirmed - i'll upload CSV + a vega-lite spec by Wed 10am. CSV sample header: model,seq_bucket,tokens_per_s,latency_95_ms,cost_per_million,tokens_cached_on,tokens_cached_off

tess: thanks. one more ask: marketing should include a short methodology blurb (how we ran benches, hardware, quant settings) to keep claims defensible.

maria: agreed. we'll add a small "How we tested" box and link to full bench artifacts. ok team, i'll circulate a checklist after ryan uploads. :white_check_mark:
